name: Custom Profile Image
description: Upload a custom PNG as your in-game avatar or namecard, bypassing the in-game camera requirement.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Pick a PNG, make it your avatar or namecard, check the preview.

added: The plugin's text now displays in your chosen language — English, 日本語 (Japanese), ไทย (Thai), Bahasa Indonesia, and Filipino. Set it in Stellar's Settings → Themes → Language (or leave it on "Follow game client").
